en: Prof. Juniper
That was a lovely flight! Thank you, Skyla! Welcome to Lentimas Town, {player}.
Bianca
Whoa, that was incredible! I never knew the whole of Unova could look so small!
Prof. Juniper
I brought you along because of what I've been tracking. Team Plasma has been after the two stones that sleep in this country, and the dragons that wait inside them.
Reshiram and Zekrom, the ones from the old tale. If their power is woken the wrong way, the ground itself will feel it.
Drayden, the Gym Leader of Opelucid City, knows the old tales far better than I do. If you can, go and hear them from him.
Bianca
And I'm going to Reversal Mountain! My research is waiting there. A volcano is the best place to see how the earth breathes!
See you around, {player}! Come and find me if you get the chance!
Prof. Juniper
Goodness, she doesn't stop for breath. I'll stay a while and take notes. If you need a ride back, the clerk by the strip will find you a seat.
Prof. Juniper
Reversal Mountain is the best place to watch the earth at work. Take care if you go in, {player}. The paths are hot and winding.
Attendant
This is the Lentimas Town landing strip. Skyla's plane flies back to Mistralton City any time you like.
Would you like a seat on the next flight?
Very well. Please wait on the strip.
Of course. Come back any time!
The little plane takes off from the strip, and the volcano's shoulder falls away beneath it.
Before long, Mistralton City's runway swings into view, with the wind sock standing out straight.
